releases.notes:
- Moved the public dashboard, answer feed and release notes to tinysearch.app.
- Service permissions now use a single TinySearch domain.

- Chrome installations and update notices use the Chrome Web Store.
- Chrome confirms available updates directly; GitHub releases awaiting store review do not trigger update notices.
- Firefox keeps GitHub downloads and release notes.

- Answers from supported Kick channels appear in DGG chat when that channel is embedded.
- Kick answer details open the channel without seeking controls.
- YouTube and Kick answers stay associated with their respective channels.
- Updated the dashboard link and extension update checks to tinysearch.up.railway.app.

- Replaced popup taglines with settings labels and source-checking guidance.
- Updated the chat preview with instructions for summaries, history, and sources.

- Lucide SVG icons throughout the interface.
- Improved answer formatting for emphasis, lists, code, quotes and tables.
- Chat summaries allow 280 characters of prose, with mentions and up to two source links counted separately.

- Update notices in the popup, browser toolbar badge, and DGG chat toolbar.
- Read release notes and check for updates from the popup.
- The public live dashboard is available on Railway.

- Chat cards show complete short summaries with up to two sources.
- Chat copy includes @Destiny and fits within 280 characters.
- Full answers remain available in the detail panel.

- TinySearch for Chrome and Firefox.
- Displays research answers in DGG chat, with searchable history and stream timestamps.
